note: The goal arrow: what the heir might do next (core/game/game_goal.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). It is a hint worked out each time from the dynasty's own state and never saved: it never moves the heir and the autopilot never reads it. `order` is the order the goals are weighed in (the first that holds is the goal, the rest are what the goal key cycles to); a step of the first-heir tutorial that names a `goal` (data/ui/tutorial.json) comes before them all. Each goal has a one-line `label` of at most `label_max` characters once its {placeholders} are filled (the words go through the `goal` text catalog). `rest_below` is the share of health under which resting at home is the goal, `pack_full_share` the share of the carrying limit over which selling is, `gold_high` the gold (before the generation's scale) over which a visit to the store is. The guided start: `first_foe` is the creature the scripted first fight is with (the weakest hostile one; its level is the highest below the heir's that the level bands call trivial or easy, else 1), put `foe_out` tiles outside the start town's `marker_gate` gate; the marker the heir first walks to is `marker_in` tiles inside that gate; reaching it is `marker_reach` tiles. The first job is `first_quest` (data/quests/quests.json), posted by the flag `guide_flag` that the open world sets for a brand new first heir, who also gets `first_pots` smoke pots. Using the family house's `home_room` rests the heir (`home_years` of the clock, as a built bedroom does).
